name: Frontend Editing
description: This module adds frontend editing functionality.

suggests.drupal/all_entity_preview: Allows previewing entities in frontend editing.

project_description:
Frontend Editing module allows users to edit entities directly on the frontend through a side panel. Unlike other modules that depend on core features like Settings Tray, Contextual Links, or Quick Edit, this module is built as a lightweight integration.

 Try Frontend Editing 

 
 Screenshots: 
 

 

 
 
 Main features/ functionalities: 
 
 Real-time Editing: 

Edit content directly in context with immediate visual feedback, updating content and experimenting with layouts, formats, and styles from the frontend interface in real time. 
 

 Frontend Link Integration: 

Adds direct links to entity editing forms on the frontend and provides a sidebar for loading these forms as iframes, enhancing content editing efficiency. 
 

 Consistent Styling: 

Editing on the frontend matches the styling of backend editing, ensuring a consistent editorial experience. 
 

 
 
 
 Requirements/ dependencies: 
 
 For module version 1.2.0 and above, twig templates for entities edited with the Frontend Editing module should include the {{ content.frontend_editing }} render element. If the template already uses {{ content }} , no changes are necessary. 
 In case the preview of the content changes are needed without actually saving the entity, consider installing "All entity preview" module. Frontend editing has full integration with preview that will help editors to see the changes before saving them inside frontend theme. 
 
 Fixes for possible issues/requests 
 As Frontend Editing integration for paragraphs depends on external module "Paragraphs Edit" , not everything regarding paragraphs can be fixed within this module. 

 There are some known issues in upstream projects, that you might need to check if you have some problems:

 
 In case of problems with revisions attribution, please check this issues [#2914976] 
 Maybe there are other issues, please check issue queue
